req.title: Fetching completed tasks
req.statement: The system shall optionally filter tasks by completed status when a filter query parameter is supplied.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /tasks/?completed=true (or false) must filter tasks by completion status. The pre-loaded dataset has exactly 6 completed tasks (ids 1,2,3,9,15,19) and 14 incomplete tasks (ids 4-8,10-14,16-18,20). Tests cover: (1) positive EP – completed=true returns exactly the 6 completed tasks with correct ids and completed=true fields; (2) positive EP – completed=false returns exactly the 14 incomplete tasks; (3) negative NEG – invalid non-boolean value for completed returns HTTP 422; (4) BVA – no filter parameter returns all 20 tasks (boundary: filter absent vs present); (5) DT – completed=true combined with limit=1 returns exactly 1 completed task; (6) BVA boundary – limit at exact boundary value 1 with completed=true returns exactly 1 item. Each test asserts exact counts, exact field values, and exact status codes to maximise mutation kill rate.

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./tasks.db')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
